name: Vatican City

system.type: No popular elections; the pope (head of state) is elected by the College of Cardinals in conclave
system.elects: The Bishop of Rome (pope), by a two-thirds majority of cardinal electors

wildFacts.text: 133 cardinal electors took part, the most ever; 89 votes were needed.
Robert Prevost, born in Chicago, became the first American pope, as Leo XIV, on the fourth ballot.
The new pope first dresses in the 'Room of Tears' before appearing to the crowd.

notes: Leo XIV is the 267th Bishop of Rome (Vatican News). Not a popular election; parties empty. Cardinal age limit (under 80) not confirmed on the cited page: omitted.
